## WP3-2A proposal review

- [ ] Raw provider bytes and SHA are present.
- [ ] Freshness/session evidence is explicit.
- [ ] Coverage and Identity Diff are reviewed.
- [ ] Provider change, if any, is explicitly approved.
- [ ] `WP3-2A / Lineage Gate` passed.
- [ ] Runtime Acceptance passed.
- [ ] Candidate, Research, real account and simulation files are unchanged.
- [ ] Orders are zero and `trade_authority=NONE`.

Merging a data-proposal PR does **not** promote Current. Run the protected acceptance workflow afterward.
